documents.title: Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors - Transcript
Presentation - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026
Recording - Conference Call with the Fund Managers, Analysts and Investors on October 29, 2026

analysis.summary: Wheels India reported growth in export revenues for both Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27. The company is focusing on expanding its capacity across various segments including auto steel wheels, cast alloy wheels, and energy products. Management aims to improve ROCE and RONW through cost optimization, working capital management, and growth in specific business lines. Capex for FY27 is estimated between Rs 400 to Rs 450 crores. Wheels India Limited reported a consolidated gross revenue of 1,492.79 Cr for Q1 FY27, representing a 17.7% growth compared to Q1 FY26.

guidance.claim: The company estimates its FY27 capex to be between Rs 400 crores and Rs 450 crores.
guidance.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

demand_outlook.claim: Export revenues grew by 30% year-on-year in Q2 FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects the effect of the West Asia crisis to potentially last for at least a year.
demand_outlook.quote: I feel the effect of this may be there for a year, at least, that's what at least the experts are saying.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned capex is directed towards expanding capacity in auto steel wheels, cast alloy wheels, energy products, hydraulic cylinders, construction & mining wheels, and air suspension.
capex_expansion.quote: This capex is towards expansion of capacity in auto steel wheels, cast alloy wheels, energy products division including large machining, hydraulic cylinders, construction & mining wheels and air suspension .

capex_expansion.claim: The company spent INR261 crores towards capex in the previous year.
capex_expansion.quote: In terms of capex, last year, we basically spent about INR261 crores towards capex, which is both in terms of investment towards the windmill business, aluminium business and a little bit of the off-road businesses and some routine capex and cost savings totalling INR261 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Management expects capex in the current year to be between INR280 crores and INR300 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: And we expect in the current year, it will be between INR280 crores to INR300 crores of capex.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board has approved a capex of about INR280 crores for the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: So 2 things. One is the capex approved for the Board is about INR280 crores at the moment.

capex_expansion.claim: Aluminium wheel capacity is increasing from 42,000 per month to 60,000 in a few months, and then to 80,000 by half year.
capex_expansion.quote: In aluminium wheels we currently have a capacity of about 42,000 per month. We are increasing it -- in a few months we are increasing it to 60,000 and then by half year, we'll increase it to 80,000.

margins_costs.claim: The company is focusing on cost optimization with a thrust on profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Cost optimization, with a thrust on profitability

margins_costs.claim: Industrial Component division EBIT improved by 91% largely because the hydraulic cylinder and fabrication divisions were positive in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: On the segmental reporting, our Industrial Component division, while the growth in top line was 12%. The EBIT improvement was 91%, largely due to the fact that last year, both the hydraulic cylinder and the fab division were loss-making. But in the fourth quarter of this year, both of them were positive.

margins_costs.claim: The company adopted a more stringent rule for inventory provisioning leading to higher provisions.
margins_costs.quote: The inventory provisions are higher, though it is grouped together. And inventory provisions are higher because a company has adopted a more stringent rule for provisioning.

margins_costs.claim: The company recorded a net forex profit of about INR4 crores in the current quarter and close to INR10 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: So in the current quarter, we had a profit of about INR4 crores as a net thing on the forex. And for the whole year, it is about close to INR10 crores as forex gain.

margins_costs.claim: Present interest cost is around INR26 crores to INR27 crores a quarter, totalling about INR111 crores for the whole year.
margins_costs.quote: See, the present interest cost is around INR26 crores, INR27 crores a quarter, totalling about INR111 crores for the whole year.

orders_capacity.claim: Passenger car steel wheels capacity is about 4 million for Wheels India and about 7 million for its subsidiary.
orders_capacity.quote: So if you take passenger car, steel wheels between us and our subsidiary, if I look at it combined, I think Wheels India has got a capacity of about 4 million and the subsidiary has got a capacity of about 7 million.

orders_capacity.claim: Tractor wheel capacity for larger wheels is 50,000 a month.
orders_capacity.quote: take the tractor industry, if you count it in terms of the larger wheels as opposed to the smaller wheels, we have a capacity of 50,000 a month.

orders_capacity.claim: Commercial vehicle space capacity including light commercial vehicle is about 250,000.
orders_capacity.quote: Commercial vehicle space, if you look at it, we have a capacity -- including the light commercial vehicle, if you look at it, we have about 250,000 capacity and we'll probably look at increasing that to 300,000 capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company intends to fund capex primarily through accruals while maintaining debt at current levels.
capital_allocation.quote: Fund capex predominantly thro accruals and holding the debt at current levels

capital_allocation.claim: Debt has been stable to declining, and debt equity and debt-to-EBITDA have improved along with reasonably strong free cash flows.
capital_allocation.quote: Our debt has been stable to declining. Debt equity has improved. Debt-to-EBITDA has improved and free cash flows are reasonably strong, especially when you compare it to the COVID period and immediate past.

capital_allocation.claim: Inventory days were reduced from 76 days to 63 days.
capital_allocation.quote: So we've reduced our inventory from 76 days to 63 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Debtor days were reduced from 61 to 54.
capital_allocation.quote: We have reduced our debtor days from 61 to 54.

risks_headwinds.claim: Aluminium was largely bought from the Middle East, requiring the company to re-source when availability and prices were impacted.
risks_headwinds.quote: Aluminium, we were buying major quantities from the Middle East. So we had to re-source and also aluminium prices have gone up.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors.
management_commitments.quote: Grow exports of wheels for construction equipment and agricultural tractors

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to ramp-up the expanded facility for machining of large castings for windmills and increase capacity for fabricated structural parts for windmills.
management_commitments.quote: Ramp-up the expanded facility for machining of large castings for windmills; Also Step up the capacity and volumes of the fabricated, structural parts for windmills, including off- shore WEGs

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to grow the hydraulic cylinder business.
The company plans to ramp-up the cast aluminium wheel business.
The company plans to grow the bus air suspension business.
Management estimates FY27 capex to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs.
management_commitments.quote: Capex of FY27 is estimated to be in the region of Rs 400 to Rs 450 crs

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to reach double-digit EBITDA in the next 1 to 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: I think as and when that happens, I think we're probably 2 years away -- 1 or 2 years away from double-digit EBITDA. I don't think it should take longer than that.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets an ROCE of 18% plus and a return on equity of 15% plus.
management_commitments.quote: I would look at our ROCE being 18% plus, I would look at our return on equity to be 15% plus.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
